svg.title: Proposal C — Stacked Phase Cards (creative approach)
svg.text: Run the tests and show me the output of cargo test
All 42 tests pass. I've also fixed the unused import warning in src/lib.rs.
test result: ok. 42 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored
• Each phase of tool execution is a separate card: Identity → Input → Output → Metadata
• Cards connected by dashed lines with dots — visual timeline of execution flow
• Active/main phase card gets elevated shadow — draws eye to the output
• Color-coded left borders: blue=input, green=output, orange=identity, grey=metadata
• Specialized rendering INSIDE the output card (terminal, diff, file, or mono text)
• Compact pill shapes (rx=19) flow naturally like tags — wrapping across lines
• Colored circle icon prefix: orange for tools, purple for subagents
• Tooltip on hover shows 3-line preview (command, first output line, timing)
• Identity card shows raw tool_name; Input card shows pretty JSON; Output card shows mono text
• Metadata card always shows available fields (duration, output size, parser info)
Identity → Input → Output → Metadata cards • Phase timeline • Pill chips with tooltip preview
